plugin.name: GTA III Definitive Edition Fusion Fix
SkipMenu.description: Resume the selected save once the frontend is ready. Restart required.
SaveSlot.description: One-based slot used by startup resume and quicksave. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiply the gameplay camera field of view; larger is wider. Cutscenes, scripted cameras and zoom views keep the game's own field of view.
RestoreOriginalCamera.description: Restores the original camera profiles, including the top-down view, and a San Andreas-style controller response.
CenteringDelay.description: Seconds before the vehicle camera centres behind the vehicle again. The original game uses 1.
RawMouseInput.description: Reads the mouse directly for the camera, with the mouse sensitivity and inversion of the game's settings.
VisualStyle.description: 0: Definitive Edition; 1: PS2 colour adaptation; 2: PC colour adaptation. Native tonemapping and HDR remain active.
RestoreWeatherColours.description: Restore original weather colours with the selected classic colour adaptation.
ColourFilterStrength.description: Strength of the classic colour adaptation, from zero to one.
ClassicLODsOnly.description: Keep regular maps and original object LODs resident. This can increase memory use and streaming cost. Restart required.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the mouse in the game window during mouse gameplay. Release it in menus or while unfocused.
TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix settings; Auto follows the system.
checkforupdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
startup.unsupported: This version of LibertyCity.exe isn't supported. The Fusion Fix needs the current version of the game (the November 2024 update or newer). The game starts without the fix.
hudaspect.description: Constrains the HUD to an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9 on wider screens. Auto uses the whole screen.
